description: Fired in the browser when a menu item is chosen (custom items, trend page / popup items). Attach Popup, Navigate or Script actions here. Like every component event, this payload can be imitated by a page script; the audit log (auditId) is the authoritative record.

action.description: Id of the chosen item (custom item id, or trendPage / trendPopup / copyPath).

tagPath.description: Full path of the tag shown by the component.
